Ok this game is chill, it is basically Left 4 Dead 3, and it is alot of fun. but to be honest theres alot to unlock and it is quite the challenge. it is alot more fun with friends, but you can play with randoms or solo and it is still fun. But one thing i cant stress enough, is theres not enough story missions. they have added 2 DLCs to the game, and the first one was ehh. i have not played the second one, but from the looks of it, there is still not a whole lot of story missions. they are planning on adding more DLCs, and im just waiting for it to be completely finished, and then i will play through it again. i have beaten this campaign so many times and unlocked everything to the point where theres nothing to do. all in all great game, there just needs to be more to keep my interest.

It's not very good. 

I bought it to play with my brother. Back4Blood becomes boring extremely quickly. We played for about 20 hours and then got bored and now we're playing other stuff because there's nothing bringing us back 4 blood. 

There's not very much depth here at all. 

It was a game advertised as a new left4dead with the same team but it's like three people out of hundreds of the original left4dead team and it shows. 

Now they are adding DLC while leaving the original game in a medicore state. 

I'm not sure who this game is really for. There are much better horde shooters out there that have way more mileage and don't get boring so quickly. Not to mention, most of them don't cost the AAA price this game demands. 

It's also an experience full of bugs and flaws. We frequently saw zombies stuttering/zooming as well as the bot teammates. If you walk anywhere near a ledge you will suddenly be hanging off of it. Even ledges that are only a few feet off the ground. There's a wide choice of weapons but only a few of them are actually viable. There's literally no reason to ever use a sniper rifle because they suck. 

The card system adds very little replay value because there's only a few good builds. I experimented a lot with different builds but most of them feel very under powered while a few feel very strong. 

Overall, I regret getting this game and I don't think we'll be playing it much more going forward. I'm certainly not coughing up even more money for DLC. Fix the vanilla game first. Then, maybe, if you finally deliver even a fraction of what was promised, we would think about giving you more money. As it is now, skip this game and pick something actually good with some real replay value.
